locked_architecture_decisions.cms_backbone: Supabase (Postgres) + lightweight hand-rolled /admin for non-technical staff editing. Chosen over headless CMS or static-TS so every later phase (e-commerce, CRM, subscriptions, dashboards) plugs into one source of truth without a rebuild.
locked_architecture_decisions.events: CMS-managed listings + external ticket/RSVP link (Eventbrite/Stripe). No custom ticketing in MVP per brief allowance.
locked_architecture_decisions.lead_capture: Every form submission persisted to Supabase (type + source tagged, CRM-ready) AND emailed via per-form routing. Resilient: DB and email run in separate try/catch so neither failure drops a lead.
locked_architecture_decisions.scope_posture: Foundation-first — DB + admin + all MVP pages/forms shipped this phase.

developer_questions_answered.best_platform: Next.js (App Router) + Supabase + Vercel + Resend — real custom, full IP ownership, no theme lock-in.
developer_questions_answered.location_specific_menus: Per-location menu_categories/menu_items in Postgres with availability + sold-out flags; staff edit in /admin, public pages revalidate via cache tags (no redeploy).
developer_questions_answered.event_ticketing: Listings + external ticket link for MVP; custom ticketing deferred.
developer_questions_answered.form_routing: Per-form: catering, tray order (-> catering + Kyle), careers (-> hiring), contact. All persisted + emailed.
developer_questions_answered.crm: Leads land in a normalized, jsonb-payload table — HubSpot/CRM export or dashboards are a read away. CRM choice can be deferred without rework.
developer_questions_answered.future_ecommerce_subscriptions_wholesale: Normalized catalog (price numeric, availability) + Supabase Auth + RLS already in place; these extend additively.
developer_questions_answered.analytics: To wire in Phase 2 (GA4/Vercel Analytics + conversion events on form success).
